learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to flip your sentences like a grammar ninja by changing who is doing the action!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🏃 The Active Voice (Doer is the Star)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In the Active Voice, the Subject is the hero doing the action! It is direct and strong. Example: 'The cat chased the mouse.' (The cat is the star doing the chasing!).

main_concepts.concept_title: 🛋️ The Passive Voice (Receiver is the Star)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In the Passive Voice, we flip the sentence! The thing receiving the action becomes the star at the front. Example: 'The mouse was chased by the cat.' We use the magic word 'by'.
To change Active to Passive, just swap the Subject and the Object, and change the verb to a helper verb format! 'Rohan painted the picture' becomes 'The picture was painted by Rohan'.

fun_activity.title: 🔄 The Grammar Ninja Flip
fun_activity.instructions: Take this active sentence: 'My mother baked a delicious cake.' Now, be a grammar ninja and flip it to the passive voice starting with 'A delicious cake...'

quick_recap: ⭐ Active Voice focuses on WHO is doing the action (The boy threw the ball).
⭐ Passive Voice focuses on WHAT received the action (The ball was thrown by the boy).
⭐ We often use the word 'by' in passive sentences to show who did it at the end!
